description: Single storey rear extension with an overall depth of 6m, a maximum height of 3.15m, and an eaves height of 3m. (PRIOR APPROVAL)
decision_conditions: Proposal is not permitted development due to the proposed extension being more than half the width of the original dwelling (where there is a staggered original rear wall or where the proposal extends beyond the rear wall).  Even with the intent to demolish the furthest forward rear wall, case law advises that the 'original' rear wall is the element to be taken into consideration at the time of validation.

The Local Authority is permitted to refuse an application if the proposal is in breach of Condition A.4 of Schedule 2 Part 1 Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015.
